intro: Every site under the CEC portfolio operates under one safety protocol, not six. Drills are scheduled, scored, and audited on a fixed annual cycle.

scenarioMatrix.protocol: Immediate evacuation via marked routes, headcount at muster point, fire warden sign-off.
Isolate zone, activate containment kit, ventilate, notify EHS lead.
First-aid responder dispatched, ambulance called, incident logged within 1 hour.
Halt elevated works, shelter-in-place, resume only after all-clear from site safety officer.
Do not touch suspicious item, quiet evacuation, perimeter lockdown, police notified immediately.
Run-Hide-Fight protocol, lockdown non-affected zones, real-time coordination with responding units.
Full SGSecure activation, site lockdown, evacuation or shelter per threat type, command handover to authorities.
Isolate affected systems, activate incident response team, preserve logs, notify CSA within statutory window.
